notes: v577 — A BADGE NOW HAS TO CLEAR COSTS, NOT JUST LUCK. This is the answer to ‘18 SOLID lines’. Those lines are real — a market with no edge at all produces zero of them, so the statistics are sound — but SOLID only ever asked ‘is this distinguishable from luck?’, and on thousands of sightings a +$0.12-per-$100 edge passes that test easily. The app's own gauge calls anything under $0.50 ‘too small’ because brokerage and the spread eat it. So a line that passes the statistics but fails the money test now reads PROVEN · TOO SMALL, is left out of the SOLID and PROMISING counts, and can no longer badge a share. Signals that work BACKWARDS (a buy signal whose edge is negative) are never badged either. Warning lines that genuinely catch falls keep their badges. Expect your counts to drop sharply — what's left is proven AND worth trading. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
